build_pre_step: build pre-step operations for the torax simulation step function call
run_finalize_outputs: run finalize outputs to compute final state and post-processed outputs after a simulation timestep
update_pedestal_transition_state: update pedestal transition state by evaluating P_SOL vs P_LH for L-H mode transitions
update_adaptive_transport: update pedestal transition state for ADAPTIVE_TRANSPORT mode with simple L-mode H-mode hysteresis
update_adaptive_source: update pedestal transition state for ADAPTIVE_SOURCE mode with full 4-state machine and dithering support
